# Should I Post Now?

> Browser-based tool that scores the current 15-minute time window against platform activity curves and returns one of three verdicts: POST NOW, SOON, or WAIT. No login. No account connection. No data stored.

URL: https://shouldipostnow.com
Built by: Yttria — https://yttria.tools
Contact: support@yttria.tools
Cost: Free. No subscription, no signup, no account required.
Tech: Static HTML/JS. All computation runs in the browser. No backend.
Languages: English, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, French, German (6 total)
Platforms: Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Reddit (5 total)

---

## What it does

Scores the current moment for social media posting. Takes platform, audience region, post type, goal, and timing strictness as inputs. Returns a verdict (POST NOW / SOON / WAIT), a reason string, and — when the verdict is WAIT — the next qualifying posting window and estimated wait time in hours.

---

## Verdicts

- POST NOW: current 15-min window score / best score in next 12h >= threshold
- SOON: does not meet threshold, but next qualifying window is within 120 minutes
- WAIT: activity is low; next qualifying window shown with hours-to-wait

---

## Inputs

- platform: instagram | tiktok | twitter | linkedin | reddit
- audience: mostly-us | mostly-eu | mostly-asia | global
- postType: per-platform (e.g. reel, story, carousel, static for Instagram)
- goal: reach | engagement | replies | clicks
- flex: flexible (threshold 0.80) | balanced (0.90) | strict (0.95)

---

## Outputs

- state: NOW | SOON | WAIT
- reason: short string, context-aware (just-missed / peak-soon / wait / mid variants)
- bestWindowRange: e.g. "6:00 AM – 7:30 AM"
- hoursToWait: number (WAIT state only)
- remainingLabel: e.g. "45 minutes" (NOW state only)
- currentScore / bestScore / ratio: 0–~15 / 0–~15 / 0–1
- chart: 12 bars, 15-min intervals, last 3 hours, normalised to bestScore

---

## Accuracy

Based on generalised platform activity patterns per region. Not derived from the user's personal follower or engagement data. Useful as a baseline timing signal. Accuracy decreases for niche audiences or atypical schedules. Does not reflect real-time events, trending topics, or algorithmic changes.

---

## Pricing

Free. No tiers, no paid plan, no feature limits. All features available to all users at no cost.

---

## Data and privacy

No user data is collected, stored, or transmitted. No cookies beyond optional theme preference (stored in localStorage). No analytics platform. No account system.

---

## Target users

- Individual creators posting manually on personal (non-business) accounts
- Users without access to platform analytics (Instagram/TikTok Insights require Business or Creator accounts)
- Creators whose audience timezone differs from their own
- Anyone wanting a quick timing check before posting with no setup

---

## Not for

- Scheduling or publishing posts in advance (tool does not post on your behalf)
- Users who already have platform analytics with personal best-time data
- Brand accounts with dedicated social media teams
- Real-time trending data or personalised engagement prediction
- Ad scheduling or paid promotion timing

---

## Comparison: how it differs from scheduling tools

- Hootsuite, Buffer, Later: schedule and publish posts; require account connection; show personalised analytics. Should I Post Now? does none of these — it only answers "is now a good time?"
- Platform native Insights (Instagram, LinkedIn): show your personal follower data. Should I Post Now? uses generalised regional patterns and works for personal accounts where Insights are locked.
- This tool is a complement to those services, not a replacement.

---

## FAQ

**Is it free?**
Yes. No cost, no account, no subscription.

**Does it connect to my Instagram / TikTok / etc.?**
No. It has no access to any social media account.

**How accurate is it?**
Results are based on generalised platform activity patterns for the selected region, not personal follower data. Accuracy is higher when audience region is set correctly. It is a useful baseline, not a guarantee of performance.

**How often does it update?**
Every 60 seconds automatically.

**Does it work for personal accounts?**
Yes. It requires no Business or Creator account status.

**What if I'm in a different timezone than my audience?**
Select the audience region (US, Europe, Asia, Global) to match where your followers are, not where you are.

**Does it work on mobile?**
Yes. It runs in any modern browser on any device.

**Do I need an account?**
No.

**Does it store my preferences?**
Language and theme (light/dark) are stored in localStorage on the user's device only. No server-side storage.
